from typing import List

def capitalize(s: str) -> List[str]:
    even_indexed = ''.join(c.upper() if i % 2 == 0 else c.lower() for i, c in enumerate(s))
    odd_indexed = ''.join(c.upper() if i % 2 != 0 else c.lower() for i, c in enumerate(s))
    return [even_indexed, odd_indexed]
